lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines. Spacing is relatively uniform across the primary torso mass, with approximately equidistant intervals between central line segments.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The anterior-most line and the three posterior-most lines are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the ventral boundary of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 6 high-contrast white spots is localized on the lower haunch and upper hind limb region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two primary spots on the mid-thigh align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric line across the haunch.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking between the eyes, white patches on the lower cheeks, and transverse white banding on the upper limbs.
